# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `agent-relay` MCP server pointing at Agent Relay's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://agentrelay.com/cloud/api/v1/mcp/relay-events`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Agent Relay sign-in — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: Agent Relay's official mark, the `favicon.svg` from agentrelay.com, centered on a square canvas.
